summary: A multi-engine synth and sequencer firmware continued from Felucca, with fifteen engines across four tracks and a focus on live sound design: morphing between engines, snapshots and held textures.
features: Engines include SEM, HADES, DRONE, ENSEMBLE, FM6, PHYS, VOICE and GRAIN
Four tracks sharing 8 voices; 64-step sequencer with locks and automation
"Pair Morph", Random Morph snapshots and hands-free Morph Journeys
STASIS freezes and layers the reverb send into a held texture
HARMONY chord progression that tracks, arps and live keys follow
USB and TRS MIDI with MIDI learn; project format changes between versions

headings: caravel 0.9.0 — random morph and journey per track

caravel 0.7.0 — smoother audio and visible performance automation
